newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Orogen says has currency,oil benefits.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Orogen says has currency,oil benefits.

text.p: Orogen Minerals Ltd, the mining arm of the Papua New Guinea government, said on Monday that its net profit in the first eight months of operation was boosted by strong oil prices and currency gains.

The company, which listed in November 1996 and began operations in May 1996, said net profit before abnormal items to December 31 was 16.42 million kina compared with the prospectus forecast of 12.60 million kina.
"This is an excellent result with solid performances from our project interests, particularly Kutubu which has benefited from stronger oil prices," Orogen chairman David Beatty said.
